meta_description:
1,251 likes, 12 comments - travelandleisure on October 21, 2026: "Meet downtown Phoenix’s newest hotel: Denū Hotel & Spa. We were the first to stay at the 236-room retreat, which brings desert-inspired design, a rooftop pool with skyline views, and a hammam-inspired spa to the heart of the city. There’s also a lineup of restaurants and bars, including Nidos Rooftop Bar.

Head to the link in our bio for T+L’s @maddiehiatt’s full review of @denuhotel.".
